final: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count FROM station_stats) SELECT station_stats.observstation, station_stats.avg_bandusagepct, station_stats.record_count, station_stats.record_count * 1.0 / group_avg.avg_record_count FROM station_stats CROSS JOIN group_avg ORDER BY station_stats.record_count * 1.0 / group_avg.avg_record_count DESC LIMIT 10
